written.headline: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and board chair
written.summary: Nvidia’s board voted unanimously to reinstate co‑founder Jensen Huang as president, chief executive officer and board director, effective immediately, less than two weeks after his resignation. The decision followed discussions with Huang and input from senior U.S. government officials.

written.headline: U.S. Commerce Department to add Megaspeed to Entity List, restricting chip sales
written.summary: The Commerce Department plans to place Singapore‑based AI infrastructure provider Megaspeed on the Entity List on Monday, requiring U.S. firms to obtain a license before selling chips. The move follows investigations into alleged export violations involving Nvidia chips.

written.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to auto‑review and approve GitHub pull requests
written.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Ship, a beta feature for Claude Team and Enterprise customers that lets Claude review, fix and approve GitHub pull requests based on team policies. The product includes PR Steward and Claude Approvals agents that handle failing CI checks, merge conflicts and routine approvals.

written.headline: Sarvam defends hosting Chinese models, releases upgraded 105B model
written.summary: Sarvam AI co-founder Pratyush Kumar defended hosting Chinese open-weight models on its Token Factory inference platform, saying it runs on privately procured GPUs, and the company released an upgraded 105-billion-parameter model, Sarvam-105B-1711.
